dataset: Environment Agency LiDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM), 1 m
processing: 1 m DTM subset to 800 m square; sampled at 2 m into textured-by-elevation GLB; vertical exaggeration 5x. No buildings, vegetation, or photographic texture.
historical_limit: Contemporary terrain only; post-dates 1848 and cannot establish historic ground shape or assembly location.
